title: PhD position in IC Design group
field: Electrical Engineering - analog and RF integrated circuit design
about: The IC Design group (EEMCS) at the University of Twente has an open-call PhD vacancy: a full-time, four-year appointment with a first-year qualifier. It asks for an MSc in Electrical Engineering specialising in analog or RF design, and fluent English.
requirements: MSc in Electrical Engineering, specialising in analog or RF design
Fluent English (TOEFL or IELTS score required)
